name: Intellichat | AI Chatbot, Live Chat, FAQs & Customer support
author: Siteskyline Plugins

sections.description:
Intellichat AI Chatbot lets you add a powerful AI chatbot to your WordPress website with just a few clicks. Help your visitors get answers to their questions instantly, improve customer engagement, and reduce support tickets.

Video Tutorial

Watch how to create your AI chatbot and integrate it with WordPress:

Features

  • Easy setup – just enter your Intellichat chatbot ID
  • Lightweight integration that doesn’t slow down your site
  • Mobile-friendly responsive design
  • Customizable appearance through the Intellichat dashboard
  • Train your chatbot on your website content
  • Powered by Google Gemini AI technology

How to Use

  1. Sign up at Intellichat.io
  2. Create a new chatbot and get your chatbot ID
  3. Install this plugin and enter your chatbot ID in the settings
  4. That’s it! Your chatbot is now live on your website

How to Create a Chatbot ID

  1. Go to app.intellichat.io and sign up for free
  2. Create a new chatbot
  3. Go to Settings and add your Gemini API key (obtain from Google AI Studio)
  4. Save settings
  5. Go to Source tab and enter your website URLs you want to train
  6. When status shows “Completed”, your chatbot is ready
  7. Copy the project ID found in front of the project title
  8. Paste the ID into your WordPress plugin settings

To customize your chatbot appearance, visit app.intellichat.io and navigate to the Customize section.

External Service

This plugin connects to the Intellichat service to provide AI chatbot functionality. The chatbot uses advanced AI technology to provide intelligent responses to your website visitors. To get started:

  1. Sign up for free at app.intellichat.io
  2. Create your chatbot and customize its appearance
  3. Add your Gemini API key from Google AI Studio
  4. Train your chatbot on your website content
  5. Copy your project ID and paste it into the WordPress plugin settings

For more information and advanced customization options, visit Intellichat.io.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the intellichat-ai-chatbot folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Intellichat AI Chatbot
  4. Enter your Intellichat chatbot ID and save changes
sections.faq:
Where do I get my chatbot ID?

Visit app.intellichat.io and sign up for free. Create a new chatbot, then go to Settings and add your Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. After saving settings, go to the Source tab and enter your website URLs for training. Once the status shows “Completed”, your chatbot is ready. The project ID is displayed in front of the project title – this is your chatbot ID.

Sign Up For Free to get started.

Is this plugin free to use?

The plugin is free, but you may need a paid Intellichat account depending on your usage requirements.

Does this work on mobile devices?

Yes, the Intellichat chatbot is fully responsive and works great on all devices.

Can I customize how the chatbot looks?

Yes, you can customize the appearance through your Intellichat dashboard.

How does Intellichat process user interactions?

The chatbot service handles user queries through Intellichat’s systems to provide intelligent responses. For more details, visit Intellichat.io.

How do I improve my chatbot’s knowledge?

You can train your chatbot on specific URLs through the Source tab in your Intellichat dashboard. This helps your chatbot learn from your website content and provide more relevant answers.
